name: my-software-factory
description: msf-v2: the minimal software factory — one headless orchestrator that drains a pool of works into PRs

scripts.build:image: docker build --build-arg AGENT_UID=$(id -u) --build-arg AGENT_GID=$(id -g) -t msf-v2-worker:local docker
scripts.proof:real: MSF_REAL_PROOF=1 npm run build && MSF_REAL_PROOF=1 node --test --test-timeout=14400000 dist/e2e/sandcastle-real.test.js
